up: Retrieve data for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614146. Return the canonical SMILES of the compound, the exact standard activity value, the standard activity units, the standard activity type, and the standard relation. Ensure the activity values are exact (i.e., standard_relation is '=').
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614146' AND a.standard_relation = '='
